Lead Prediction System: Led development of an automated pipeline to identify
potential leads from user-configured websites using Python, web scraping, and
LLMs. Integrated Airflow for weekly alerts, reducing manual monitoring and
accelerating lead discovery.
Risk Prediction for Tenders: Built a risk detection model using existing libraries,
Advanced RAG, and LLM agents to analyze historical tender data, improving early

RFQ Automation Platform: Architected an end-to-end system to automate
procurement identification and RFQ generation, extracting and summarizing
procurement information across all pages using LLM- and agent-based pipelines.
Integrated a chatbot interface to answer user queries on tender projects, reducing
processing effort and turnaround time.
LLM-Powered Search Engine: Developed an intelligent chatbot for 15,000+
unstructured documents, designed for senior decision-makers to efficiently
retrieve information from past tenders. Leveraged Databricks, custom section
detection, and intelligent chunking to improve search accuracy and relevance.
AI Auto-Completion System: Built a GPT-powered feature that recommends
responses dynamically as users type, improving accuracy, speeding up drafting,
and assisting users in generating or modifying answers directly in the answer box.
RAG-Based Response Assistant: Implemented GPT-powered features for first-
draft generation, summarization, proofreading, and readability enhancement
using RAG pipelines, enabling users to draft or modify responses in real time,
resulting in faster and higher-quality RFQ response creation.
Enhanced Recommendation Engine: Upgraded the recommendation pipeline by
integrating Ada embeddings with larger embedding dimensions than BERT,
achieving 60% improvement in accuracy and relevance for RFP suggestions.
Document Summarization: Developed a hybrid summarization pipeline
combining BERT-based extractive techniques with GPT models to generate
concise, high-quality summaries that capture critical content efficiently.
Document Analysis & Requirement Detection: Built an NLP-driven system using
open-source libraries to extract key information (dates, sections, locations,
organizations, job titles, laws, monetary values, names, percentages, contact
details, URLs, domain-specific keywords) and fine-tuned BERT/T5 for sentence
classification to automate question/statement identification, achieving 85%
efficiency improvement.
Answer Snippet Extraction: Designed a SQuAD fine-tuned BERT model to retrieve
the most contextually relevant portions of answers from large unstructured
documents, eliminating manual navigation and speeding up information retrieval.
Important Keyword Extraction: Implemented an algorithm leveraging SpaCy,
NLTK, TextRank, RAKE, YAKE, KeyBERT to extract meaningful, domain-specific
keywords, enhancing search functionality and retrieval accuracy.
Recommendation Engine: Designed an ML-powered retrieval pipeline using BERT
vector embeddings and similarity search to suggest the most relevant questions
from a database, increasing efficiency in responding to RFPs.
